title: Self-Supervised Learning of Universal Latent Spaces for Operator Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05735v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural operators fit their representation of functions to the task they are trained on, so every new task rebuilds a reduced space from labeled data. Following the self-supervised pre-training that made representations shareable in natural language processing and computer vision, we decouple representation learning from operator learning. A functional autoencoder is pre-trained on analytic functions synthesized on the fly, with no solver and no labels, to represent functions on arbitrary point clouds, and the latent space it induces is frozen and reused across tasks. The representation is exactly equivariant to translation, dilation, and amplitude, and reconstructs solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) and natural images on geometries it never saw. translated_title: 面向算子学习的通用潜在空间自监督学习
translated_abstract: 神经算子将其函数表示拟合到所训练的特定任务上，因此每遇到一个新任务都需要从带标签数据重新构建一个降维空间。借鉴自然语言处理和计算机视觉领域中使表示可共享的自监督预训练思想，我们将表示学习与算子学习解耦。具体而言，在一个即时合成解析函数的函数自编码器上进行预训练，无需求解器、无需标签，使其能够在任意点云上表示函数，其诱导出的潜在空间被冻结并在多个任务间复用。该表示对平移、缩放和幅度具有精确的等变性，并能够在其从未见过的几何结构上重构偏微分方程（PDE）的解以及自然图像。由于该潜在空间与任务无关，其本身也可以被独立地解释。整个潜在空间都被充分利用并能解码为有效的物理场，同时保留了物理…（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出通过在即时合成、无标签无求解器的解析函数上自监督预训练函数自编码器，学习一个对平移、缩放和幅度精确等变的通用潜在空间，将其冻结后可在任意点云上跨任务复用于算子学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes self-supervised pre-training of a functional autoencoder on label-free, solver-free analytic functions synthesized on the fly, learning a universal latent space exactly equivariant to translation, dilation, and amplitude that can be frozen and reused across operator learning tasks on arbitrary point clouds.
